notes: Page 86 continues Day 21 (no new day opener). Commemorations: Mary's miracle for Matthias (¶፰ + own arke, no Amharic arke); Lazarus translation (¶፱-፲፫ + own arke, no Amharic arke); new commemoration ¶፲፬ Abba John, bishop of Jerusalem (Ge'ez ends ፡ and Amharic ends mid-sentence 'የንጉሥ' at page foot; continues p87, join with space). Numerals ፰ ፱ ፲፬ read from small dotted glyphs (¶፰ and ¶፱ least certain; inferred from running sequence after Joel doxology ¶፯ on p85). Ge'ez readings to check vs PDF: ገብረት, ወአድኅኖቶ, ረድኤ (maybe ረድአ), እመዋቅሕቲሁ, arke ገንተ ሚዓ / ዘኢያይበሰኪ / ወደደክ (unclear), ፩ዱ (numeral ፩ + ዱ = አሐዱ), ¶፲ has no ሥጋሁ although Amharic has ሥጋው, ወንቡረ በግዑን, ዝንቱ (scan glyph ambiguous), እሙታን, ወጾርዎ (glyph looked like ወዮርዎ), ኵሎሙ (scan ዥ glyph), በጸሎቱ (scan could be በጸሎተ), arke ወዱስ, ዘሀገር (not ዘሀገረ), ለንጉሥነ. Amharic: ማሠሪያ, ሊአፈልሱትም, በወደዱ, ወደ ቍስጥንጥንያ (scan shows no separator before ቍ), ይማረን kept as scanned. No Amharic arke on this page.
